line.tlmformation.airdrop.arrival.1: Helicopter on station, prepare to rappel!
line.tlmformation.airdrop.arrival.2: Entering the target airspace, opening the cabin door.
line.tlmformation.airdrop.arrival.3: We're here - girls below, get ready to receive us!
line.tlmformation.airdrop.arrival_pickup: Extraction bird on station - ropes down, squad, form up and board!
At the pickup point, hatch open - everyone aboard!
Hover stable, climb the rope - we're going home.
line.tlmformation.airdrop.landing.1: Tactical insertion complete! Commander, awaiting orders!
line.tlmformation.airdrop.landing.2: Phew, windy up there - but nothing we can't handle. Everyone down safe.
line.tlmformation.airdrop.landing.3: Airdrop squad reporting in, establishing a perimeter.
line.tlmformation.airdrop.landing.4: Commander, troops from the sky delivered - please sign here!
line.tlmformation.airdrop.landing.5: Rappel complete, area secured, ready for action.
line.tlmformation.airdrop.landing.6: Heh, the enemy would never expect an attack from above!
line.tlmformation.airdrop.landing.7: Hooah! Down safe! Sisters, spread out and watch!
line.tlmformation.airdrop.landing.8: From today on, we own this airspace.
line.tlmformation.airdrop.landing.9: Feels good to be on solid ground - leave the rest to us!
line.tlmformation.airdrop.landing.10: Squad in position, we'll clear every obstacle for you!
line.tlmformation.airdrop.departure.1: Mission complete, squad extracting. Take care, Commander!
line.tlmformation.airdrop.departure.2: We're off! The rest is up to you!
line.tlmformation.airdrop.departure.3: Boarding now, heading home. Call us for the next big fight!
line.tlmformation.airdrop.departure.4: Retreating is part of tactics too - bye, Commander~
line.tlmformation.airdrop.departure.5: Door closed, seatbelts on. See you in the sky!
line.tlmformation.airdrop.departure.6: Tactical withdrawal - we'll miss you, Commander.
line.tlmformation.airdrop.departure.7: Making our getaway! Not a rout, a strategic relocation!
line.tlmformation.airdrop.departure.8: Recall order received, keep formation, ready for takeoff!
line.tlmformation.airdrop.departure.9: Time to run! The rest is on you!
line.tlmformation.airdrop.departure.10: Commander, we'll be waiting at base for your triumphant return!

voice.tlmformation.emergency.0: Emergency beacon received - First Squad has jumped in, all members present!
voice.tlmformation.emergency.1: Stay back, master - we're taking over from here.
voice.tlmformation.emergency.2: Hostile units locked on. Defensive array deployed!
voice.tlmformation.emergency.3: Sorry we're late. Your safety is our responsibility.
voice.tlmformation.emergency.4: All units, priority one: keep the commander alive!
voice.tlmformation.mark.0: Copy that, advancing to the target area.
voice.tlmformation.mark.2: Target coordinates confirmed, preparing to move.
voice.tlmformation.mark.3: All units, enter tactical maneuver mode.
voice.tlmformation.mark.4: I'll scout the path ahead for you.
voice.tlmformation.mark.5: Stay close to me and mind your footing.
voice.tlmformation.mark.6: Area scan complete - it's safe to proceed.
voice.tlmformation.mark.8: Unknown terrain ahead, recalculating the route.
voice.tlmformation.mark.9: Arrived at the objective, forming up a defensive pattern.
voice.tlmformation.lock.2: Hostile unit spotted, executing elimination protocol!
voice.tlmformation.lock.3: Target marked - whole squad, saturate it!
voice.tlmformation.lock.4: First line is up. Nothing gets through!
voice.tlmformation.lock.6: Suppressing fire! Don't give them room to breathe!
voice.tlmformation.lock.7: Support the flank, push these guys out!
voice.tlmformation.follow.0: Guard formation reforming, staying at your side.
voice.tlmformation.follow.1: I'll stay right behind you, don't worry.
voice.tlmformation.follow.2: Follow formation engaged, perimeter watch deployed.
voice.tlmformation.follow.3: Your back is ours to guard.
voice.tlmformation.follow.4: We'll clear the road ahead for you.
voice.tlmformation.follow.5: Wherever you go, the squad goes with you.
voice.tlmformation.follow.7: Keep in step, hold escort distance.
voice.tlmformation.follow.8: Move ahead with confidence - flanks are sealed.
voice.tlmformation.follow.9: Order received, returning to escort position.
voice.tlmformation.retreat.0: All units fall back! Cover each other!
voice.tlmformation.retreat.1: Line collapsing - make sure the master is safe!
voice.tlmformation.retreat.3: Tactical disengage, get back to the master, now!
voice.tlmformation.retreat.4: I'll hold the rear - everyone move!
voice.tlmformation.retreat.6: All units out of the engagement zone, regrouping.
voice.tlmformation.retreat.7: Regroup and get ready for the next counterattack.
voice.tlmformation.guard.0: Expanding the search radius, sweeping for threats.
voice.tlmformation.guard.1: Going on alert, ready to engage at any moment.
voice.tlmformation.guard.2: Releasing recon signals, monitoring every movement.
voice.tlmformation.guard.3: Nothing dangerous gets within a hundred paces.
voice.tlmformation.guard.4: Perimeter up - not even a bird gets through.
voice.tlmformation.hold.1: All units stand by, weapons loaded.
voice.tlmformation.hold.2: Garrison mode on - I'm staying right here.
voice.tlmformation.hold.3: Patrolling the area, keeping the position secure.
voice.tlmformation.hold.5: Watch posts set, ready for a surprise attack.
voice.tlmformation.hold.6: Kinda boring... when are the enemies coming?
voice.tlmformation.hold.7: Stay quiet and wait for your next order.
chat.tlmformation.group.0.0: Were you slacking off just now?
chat.tlmformation.group.0.2: Sure you were - I saw you yawn.
chat.tlmformation.group.1.0: Which personality do you think the master likes best?
chat.tlmformation.group.1.1: Has to be the gentle type. Like me.
chat.tlmformation.group.1.2: Come on, he clearly likes the obedient ones.
chat.tlmformation.group.2.0: Stop cutting me off - let the master hear me.
chat.tlmformation.group.2.1: Nobody cut you off, you're just too quiet.
chat.tlmformation.group.2.2: Can you two stop arguing? The master's speechless.
chat.tlmformation.group.3.0: I feel like the master's been looking at me differently lately.
chat.tlmformation.group.3.2: Sounds like you're still half asleep and talking in your dreams.
chat.tlmformation.group.4.0: If she and I were in danger at the same time, who would the master save first?
chat.tlmformation.group.4.1: Don't you think that question is a bit pointless?
chat.tlmformation.group.4.2: He'd definitely say: only kids pick one.
chat.tlmformation.group.5.0: Don't you think the master got a little taller recently?
chat.tlmformation.group.6.0: Master, may I lean on your shoulder for a bit?
chat.tlmformation.group.7.0: Out of the three of us, who looks the most reliable?
chat.tlmformation.group.7.1: Is that even a question? Me.
chat.tlmformation.group.7.2: I vote for her - she's the best at acting.
chat.tlmformation.group.8.0: You're always scowling. Loosen up a little.
chat.tlmformation.group.8.1: I was born with this face. Can't help it.
chat.tlmformation.group.8.2: Smile more - the master likes it.
chat.tlmformation.group.9.0: What was that look just now?
chat.tlmformation.group.9.1: Nothing. I just thought you looked kinda cute.
chat.tlmformation.group.9.2: You two, stop making eyes at each other!
chat.tlmformation.group.10.0: So, how did we do today?
chat.tlmformation.group.10.2: I'd say it was pretty much perfect.
chat.tlmformation.group.10.3: Good - at least we didn't embarrass the master.
chat.tlmformation.group.11.0: Can anyone tell me what she's actually angry about?
chat.tlmformation.group.11.1: No idea. Probably something small again.
chat.tlmformation.group.11.2: Someone should go cheer her up.
chat.tlmformation.group.11.3: Why does it have to be me?!
chat.tlmformation.group.12.0: I've noticed someone among us loves secretly staring at the master.
chat.tlmformation.group.12.3: Don't look at me - I stare openly.
chat.tlmformation.group.13.0: Everyone come here, I have an announcement.
chat.tlmformation.group.13.2: Did the master prepare a surprise for us?
chat.tlmformation.group.13.3: You can all go. I just wanted to see your reactions.
chat.tlmformation.group.14.0: Did I say something wrong just now?
chat.tlmformation.group.14.2: Don't worry, the master isn't that petty.
chat.tlmformation.group.15.0: If we didn't have to fight anymore, what would everyone want to do?
chat.tlmformation.group.15.1: I'd travel the mountains and rivers.
chat.tlmformation.group.15.2: I want to stay by the master's side forever.
chat.tlmformation.group.15.3: Same. As long as we're together.
chat.tlmformation.group.16.0: Are you two secretly plotting something again?
chat.tlmformation.group.16.2: The way they're looking at each other is suspicious.
chat.tlmformation.group.16.3: They're definitely in on it together!
chat.tlmformation.group.17.0: Could everyone quiet down a bit? I have a headache.
chat.tlmformation.group.17.2: Go rest over there for a while.
chat.tlmformation.group.17.3: I'll get you a glass of water.
chat.tlmformation.group.18.0: Don't you think everyone's in a good mood today?
chat.tlmformation.group.18.1: Probably because the master is here.
chat.tlmformation.group.18.2: Seeing the master always lifts my mood.
chat.tlmformation.group.18.3: You're hopeless - three sentences in and it's the master.
chat.tlmformation.group.19.0: I just saw someone secretly wiping their eyes. Who was it?
chat.tlmformation.group.19.3: Stop looking - maybe it was sand in the wind.
chat.tlmformation.group.20.0: Everyone stop for a moment. I think we need a quick meeting.
chat.tlmformation.group.20.1: A meeting? The master didn't give any orders.
chat.tlmformation.group.20.3: I think we should discuss who's guarding the master tomorrow.
chat.tlmformation.group.20.4: Great idea - I'm definitely putting my name in!
chat.tlmformation.group.21.0: I've noticed someone in our squad has a really short temper.
chat.tlmformation.group.22.0: If the master could only take one of us on an adventure, who would it be?
chat.tlmformation.group.22.4: I say he'd pick the quietest one. Me.
chat.tlmformation.group.23.0: Everyone stop arguing, let me have some quiet.
chat.tlmformation.group.24.0: Don't you think all this noise we make is actually nice?
chat.tlmformation.group.24.1: Yeah. Way better than being alone.
chat.tlmformation.group.24.2: As long as everyone's here, I feel safe.
chat.tlmformation.group.24.3: You're all loud, but I've gotten used to it.
chat.tlmformation.group.25.0: Who touched my hand just now?
chat.tlmformation.group.25.3: Don't look at me. I'm not that bored.
chat.tlmformation.group.26.0: Do you think the master knows how much we talk when he's not around?
chat.tlmformation.group.26.2: Hope he never finds out. That'd be so embarrassing.
chat.tlmformation.group.26.4: Then we say it was a tactical discussion!
chat.tlmformation.group.27.0: Everyone worked hard today. I propose we praise ourselves.
chat.tlmformation.group.27.4: Never mind. Let's wait for the master to praise us.
chat.tlmformation.group.28.0: Don't you think we've been getting along better lately?
chat.tlmformation.group.28.2: I agree. Even the arguments have decreased.
chat.tlmformation.group.28.3: Maybe we're all just growing up.
chat.tlmformation.group.29.0: Hey, were you just staring at the master all dreamy-eyed?
chat.tlmformation.group.29.1: I was not! Don't make things up!
chat.tlmformation.group.29.2: Your face is red. Still saying no?
chat.tlmformation.group.29.3: Ugh, stop it, this is so embarrassing.
chat.tlmformation.group.30.0: Listen up, everyone. Today's objective is...
chat.tlmformation.group.31.0: Anyone noticed the master's been really quiet lately?
chat.tlmformation.group.32.0: I declare that from now on, nobody talks to the master!
chat.tlmformation.group.32.2: You're just settling a personal grudge.
chat.tlmformation.group.32.3: Exactly. Who do you think you are?
chat.tlmformation.group.32.4: Everyone wants to talk to the master!
chat.tlmformation.group.33.0: The master seems especially happy today.
chat.tlmformation.group.34.0: Everyone watch your step, the terrain here is tricky.
chat.tlmformation.group.35.1: Hang in there, it'll be dark soon.
chat.tlmformation.group.35.2: Can we rest once it's dark?
chat.tlmformation.group.35.3: Of course not. We still have night watch.
chat.tlmformation.group.36.1: Me too. My legs don't feel like mine.
chat.tlmformation.group.36.2: I'm sleeping for three days straight when we get back.
chat.tlmformation.group.36.3: In your dreams. We've got work tomorrow.
chat.tlmformation.group.37.0: Don't you think the master is actually kind of cute?
chat.tlmformation.group.37.3: He's clumsy sometimes, but he tries hard.
chat.tlmformation.group.37.4: That's why we have to keep protecting him.
chat.tlmformation.group.39.0: Hey, look - is the master smirking?
chat.tlmformation.group.39.3: I really want to know what he's smiling at.
chat.tlmformation.group.39.4: Maybe he's thinking about something nice.
chat.tlmformation.group.39.5: Shh, spread out. Don't crowd together.
